# Aidentika

> > AI-powered product photo generation platform designed for e-commerce businesses to automate and enhance product imagery.

Aidentika is an artificial intelligence application that leverages machine learning and image processing to generate professional product photos for online retailers. The platform integrates with modern AI technologies including OpenAI and face recognition capabilities, serving the e-commerce industry with automated visual content creation.

- E-commerce automation
